title: test: compare canonical relationship acting instructions
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
## Summary
- Add a deterministic comparison using the same user input/history while changing only the canonical relationship status.
- Assert the resulting Gemini `systemInstruction` differs for `none` vs `romantic_partner`.
- Document current affection threshold behavior: scores 0 and 1 currently produce identical acting guidance, while 80 activates the high-affection instruction.

## Scope
Tests only. No production database reads/writes, no runtime behavior changes, and no assertion that a nondeterministic Gemini response must use a particular phrase.
